name: Biblical Confrontation
overview: Biblical confrontation calls for loving and humble correction among believers, emphasizing restoration over judgment. Scripture instructs us to address a brother's fault privately and gently, seeking to regain fellowship without pride or strife. True confrontation is marked by faithfulness and sincerity, as honest rebuke from a friend is more valuable than flattering deceit. This process requires self-examination and meekness, recognizing our own weaknesses while encouraging repentance and transformation away from corrupt desires.
